name: Guess Battle
summary:
Guess Battle is a free Arabic multiplayer party game played in a web browser. Players are divided into teams (Red and Blue), each with a candidate who sees the opponent's card but not their own. Candidates take turns asking yes/no questions to guess what's on their card.
A Judge verifies answers and approves guesses. Features include streamer mode, power-ups, leaderboard, and ready-made card packs across 14 categories.
